nodes.text: Identify Hazards (Situation Awareness): Gather information on objectives, communication, who's in charge, previous fire behavior, weather forecast, local factors
Assess Hazards: Estimate potential fire behavior hazards using Look Up, Down, and Around indicators

evidence.source_text: Assess Hazards • Estimate Potential Fire Behavior Hazards

nodes.text: Identify Tactical Hazards: Watch Outs. Consider what other safety hazards may exist as conditions change. Consider probability versus severity

evidence.source_text: • Identify Tactical Hazards • As conditions change, what other safety hazards are likely to exist? • Consider probability versus severity?

nodes.text: Develop Controls: Firefighting Orders, LCES, Anchor Point, Downhill Checklist, Engineering/Administrative controls, PPE, Educational, Avoidance, Emergency Medevac Procedures/Plan

evidence.source_text: Develop Controls and Make Risk Decisions • Develop control measures that reduce risk

nodes.text: Are controls in place to mitigate risk?

evidence.source_text: • Are controls in place to mitigate risk?

nodes.text: Are selected tactics based on expected fire behavior?

evidence.source_text: • Are selected tactics based on expected fire behavior?

nodes.text: Have instructions been given and understood?

evidence.source_text: • Have instructions been given and understood?

nodes.text: Implement Controls: Ensure controls are in place and being implemented by personnel. Ensure controls are integrated into operational plan and understood at all levels

evidence.source_text: Implement Controls • Ensure controls are in place and being implemented by personnel. • Ensure controls are integrated into operational plan and understood at all levels.

nodes.text: Are controls adequately mitigating the hazards?

evidence.source_text: Supervise and Evaluate • Are controls adequately mitigating the hazards?

nodes.text: Reassess situation: Consider human factors (low experience, distracted, fatigue/stress, unsafe attitude) and situational changes (what is changing, are strategy/tactics working)

evidence.source_text: Reassess and consider: - Human Factors ... - The Situation

nodes.text: Controls effective, continue operations. If situation changes significantly, restart at appropriate step

evidence.source_text: If the situation changes significantly, restart Risk Management Process at the appropriate step.
